description: The user steals the effects of any attempts to use a healing or stat-changing move.

name: Snipe Shot
description: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

name: Snore
effect: Inflicts flinch. Fails unless user is asleep.
description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

name: Soak
description: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.

name: Soft-Boiled
description: The user restores up to half of their max HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

name: Solar Beam
effect: User must wait a turn before use, except in sun. Power is halved in weather other than sun.
description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

name: Solar Blade
effect: User must wait a turn before use, except in sun. Power is halved in weather other than sun.
description: The user fills a blade with light energy on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

name: Sonic Boom

name: Spark

name: Sparkling Aria

name: Spectral Thief

name: Speed Swap

name: Spider Web
